g.text: Convergence Factory — C4 System Context & Container Architecture
Autonomous discovery, multi-probe evidence extraction, zero-dependency clustering & CI/CD ratchet governance
Executes automated PR builds and enforces
Autonomous multi-tier portfolio deduplication, opportunity scoring and closed-loop ratchet remediation
• Pub/Sub Topics: Kafka producers & consumers (kafkajs, spring)
• HTTP REST: FeignClient, RestTemplate, requests, axios
• SQL Lineage: Column-level CRUD on warehouse tables
Calculates cross-service coupling coefficient C(p1, p2)
• Capability Summarizer: Extracts intent from docs & code
• Vector Embeddings: Cosine distance nearest-neighbor recall
• Hybrid Pairwise Judge: Domain heuristics + live LLM
Eliminates false positives on generic programming terms
• Ingests OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger, Protobuf schemas & GraphQL
• Extracts declared SERVES endpoints across services
Unmasks shadow microservices serving identical APIs
• Emits standard CycloneDX SBOM per repository
• Discovers shared libraries across disparate teams
• Flags version drift & duplicate OSS library adoption
• Type-1 Clones: Exact copy-paste code segments
• Type-2 Clones: Syntactically identical with renamed vars
• Fast tokenized line hashing across multi-file windows
Zero external dependencies; runs in pure Python
• Canonical architectural contract between probes and core
• Core Entities: Project · Resource (TOPIC/TABLE) · Fact · Evidence
• Probes learn languages; Core only consumes normalized facts
Decoupled architecture: add new probes without core changes
• High-performance in-memory or persisted relational storage
• Merges multi-dimensional evidence into disjoint redundancy sets
• Computes cross-project coupling coefficient: C(p1, p2) ∈ [0, 1]
Guarantees transitive convergence without spurious clustering
Maximizes ROI: large duplications with minimal entanglement
Prevents regression by failing CI on new copies:
Java: ArchUnit rules in JUnit 5 tests
Reviewable Git PR diffs before merging
The normalized schema is the contract (core/schema.py) · Probes learn languages; Core only consumes normalized facts · Zero third-party core dependencies
